problem_statement: Add a fixed-size FIFO (queue) abstraction to Zephyr's utilities that stores equal-sized items in a circular buffer and hides item-boundary management from both the user and the underlying byte ring buffer. The queue must be initializable from a user-provided backing buffer of a given byte size and item size, and must support enqueueing an item (failing when full), dequeueing the oldest item in FIFO order (failing when empty), and reporting its state: whether it is empty or full, its capacity in items, the number of free item slots, the number of items currently held, and a reset to empty. Items written must be read back exactly and in order, including across wraparound of the underlying buffer, with a capacity equal to the whole backing buffer divided by the item size.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/lib/ringq -s tests/lib/ringq/libraries.fifo -s libraries.fifo -O twister-out --no-clean -W

verification.reason: The statement describes the behaviour well but omits every concrete name the test relies on (struct, header, macro, functions, struct fields) and the exact error code -ENODATA for get-when-empty. All of these are public-interface details that can be added to the statement without dictating the implementation.

problems.detail: The statement never gives any concrete name. The hidden test uses the struct name sys_ringq, the header path <zephyr/sys/ringq.h>, the macro SYS_RINGQ_DEFINE, and the functions sys_ringq_init, sys_ringq_put, sys_ringq_get, sys_ringq_empty, sys_ringq_full, sys_ringq_capacity, sys_ringq_space, sys_ringq_size. The test also directly reads the struct fields rb (of type struct ring_buf) and item_size. None of these names appear in the statement, so an agent cannot know what to call the new types and functions.

The test asserts sys_ringq_get returns -ENODATA when the queue is empty ('zassert_true(sys_ringq_get(&f, &output) == -ENODATA)'). The statement only says 'failing when empty' without specifying the error code, and a developer could reasonably choose any negative errno. Similarly the success return value 0 for put and get (checked via zassert_ok) is not stated.

leak_check.leak_detail: The phrase describing sys_ringq_init as initializing ringq->rb to use data as its byte buffer and data_size as its byte capacity hints at the internal initialization step, although it largely describes public behavior required by the tests.
leak_check.suggested_statement:
Add a fixed-size FIFO (queue) abstraction to Zephyr's utilities that stores equal-sized items in a circular buffer and hides item-boundary management from both the user and the underlying byte ring buffer. The queue must be initializable from a user-provided backing buffer of a given byte size and item size, and must support enqueueing an item (failing when full), dequeueing the oldest item in FIFO order (failing when empty), and reporting its state: whether it is empty or full, its capacity in items, the number of free item slots, the number of items currently held, and a reset to empty. Items written must be read back exactly and in order, including across wraparound of the underlying buffer, with a capacity equal to the whole backing buffer divided by the item size.

The public API should be in <zephyr/sys/ringq.h>, and that header must make struct ring_buf available to code that includes it. It should define struct sys_ringq with a struct ring_buf rb member and an item_size member holding the item size in bytes. Provide void sys_ringq_init(struct sys_ringq *ringq, uint8_t *data, size_t data_size, size_t item_size), which, after completion, must result in ringq->rb using data as its byte buffer and data_size as its byte capacity, ringq->item_size equal to item_size, and the queue empty. Provide SYS_RINGQ_DEFINE(name, item_size, item_capacity) that defines a static struct sys_ringq name backed by a buffer of item_size * item_capacity bytes and initializes it.

Provide int sys_ringq_put(struct sys_ringq *ringq, const void *element), which copies one item into the queue and returns 0 on success; it must fail when the queue is full. Provide int sys_ringq_get(struct sys_ringq *ringq, void *element), which copies the oldest item out and returns 0 on success or -ENODATA when the queue is empty. Provide bool sys_ringq_empty(const struct sys_ringq *ringq), bool sys_ringq_full(const struct sys_ringq *ringq), size_t sys_ringq_capacity(const struct sys_ringq *ringq), size_t sys_ringq_space(const struct sys_ringq *ringq), size_t sys_ringq_size(const struct sys_ringq *ringq), and void sys_ringq_reset(struct sys_ringq *ringq). capacity, space, and size are in items; full is true when space is zero; empty is true when size is zero; reset makes the queue empty.
